# 0.2.3

Monster decks hold 25% more cards. New permanent monster Abyss Lurker (Barrier 1, 3 damage, initiative 4; 1 VP and an Arcane Abyss Summon): always available at the Abyss, taken into the hand instead of a deck draw. Monster initiative now applies on the site.

Changes since 0.2.2: 15 changed, 1 added
